hero.title: MCH: Configuration Error Scanner
hero.description: A command-line tool for automated identification of security misconfigurations in network systems. Detects open ports, exposed files, and CORS vulnerabilities.
hero.subtitle: Bachelor's Thesis.

relevance.title: Relevance
relevance.paragraph1: The growing number of cyberattacks due to misconfigured systems has become one of the critical problems of modern IT infrastructure. According to OWASP reports, Security Misconfiguration consistently ranks in the top 10 vulnerabilities.
relevance.paragraph2: Existing tools are often too complex or resource-intensive. Developing a modular tool will enable rapid vulnerability detection at early stages.

goal.title: Research Goal
goal.text: Develop a convenient, extensible tool for automated detection and documentation of common configuration errors in web servers and network applications.

results.title: 📊 Results
list: Flexible CLI tool with modular structure
